text_block_list.text: Gold Ship claimed she was scouting a candidate location for a new training camp facility, and dragged me along almost forcefully to a recently abandoned hot spring inn—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: You saved my skin. Journey was super insistent that I bring an adult chaperone if I was going.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Setting aside me and Golshi, there's someone here who's scared out of their wits after hearing about the sinister rumors.
choice_data_list: Wait, sinister rumors?! ...Now that you mention it...

text_block_list.text: The air somehow feels strangely stagnant. And there's this eerie sense of someone watching, a presence... even though no one else should be here—

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text: Wh-Who is scared, sir?! Th-They are merely rumors, ghosts could not p-possibly exist—

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text: ! F-Footsteps? I-Is it truly a gh... N-No! It might be a suspicious trespasser. Everyone, p-please do not leave my side, sir—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Nice. Whether this paranormal stuff is the real deal or just a shady trespasser, this is gonna make one fun gamble.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I'm betting everything on ghosts! Now this is getting spicy!

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text: T-That is why... I am t-t-telling you n-not to l-leave me, sirrr!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oho, is this what they call rapping noises? HEY♪ YO♪ Put ya hands up, foot nenza YEAH♪

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text: Th-That is the wrong kind of rap—nuooh?! S-Someone just t-touched this officer's tail, sir?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's up Meno, feeling cheerful? Come over here, I found something interesting.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oho, pickled chupacabra? Or dried skyfish jerky? Or maybe melt-in-your-mouth tender char siu pork!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Aww, what, it's just a big old mirror. Should we brighten it up with some stickers? Want one too, Mame-chin?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Mame-chin?

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Hah! M-My apologies, sir. I zoned out for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text: Geez, are you done with the mirror? Please stop playing around and conduct the inspection properly, sir!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: What's the rush! Let's try out some more stuff~!
A little while later, Gold Ship returned by herself to the room with the mirror.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I feel it, I feel it... My ghost antenna is telling me this is the spot!

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text: Golshi-san? We have already inspected this area. Don't tell me you intend to deface the mirror with pranks...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, aren't you here 'cause you wanna slap some rare beast stickers on it too? Fine then, here, you can stick on the bush dog.

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text: I would appreciate it if you didn't lump me together with you. I am conducting a re-patrol. Such is the spirit of inspecting the scene a hundred times, sir.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hmph, how very splendid slipper gorilla rapper of you, sir~. By the way—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Who the hell are you?

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...What are you saying? As you can see, I am Phenomeno, sir.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Naw, you ain't. When Mame-chin gazes into Golshi-chan, Golshi-chan gazes right back into Mame-chin...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: You're no Mame-chin. At best—you're "Dame-chin" the dud!

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno?
text_block_list.text: Guh?! C-Curse you...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Total dud after all. Your comeback was lame as hell. You wouldn't even pass the preliminaries of the M-1 Grand Prix.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Go practice your guttural roars and try again—G-O-L-R-A-A-A-H-H-H-!

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno?
text_block_list.text: I-Idiot, st—GYAAAAAAAAAAAHHH—!!!

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text: —Wh-What is the commotion, s... Aaaaahhh! G-O-L-S-H-I-S-A-N!! Destroying property is a major offense, sirrrr!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Heheh, the Golshi-Style Martial Arts is nearing completion, so I accidentally put a bit too much punch into it~.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Hey? Doesn't the air feel a whole lot lighter all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Now that you mention it. That ominous sensation from earlier is completely gone, sir. Truly mysterious.

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Now that you mention it. That ominous sensation from earlier is completely gone, sir. Truly mysterious.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Like hell it is, this place is so boring!
Let's tell Journey to make it
a way cooler haunted spot!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Flash-ojisan and
the Grasshopper Boys
all made it home safe and sound after all.

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text:
You and your pointless lies again...
It is a lie, right, Golshi-san?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
They were there, alright! Orbs were poppin' out
like crazy, so I ate every single one of 'em!
By the way, they tasted like apples.

Watching Gold Ship spin her extravagant yarn,
I decided not to pry any further.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Nooot really~? Nothin' there
at aaaaall. If the crack woman showed up though,
I would've sealed her in with clay.

Feigning ignorance in her usual over-the-top way,
Gold Ship took her leave.
